description: TradeScope is Tradelia's public simulator for comparing brokers and instruments by asset, strategy, horizon, capital, and leverage.
scope_item_1: From intraday index and forex trading to position stock picking.
scope_item_2: Also covers ETF accumulation plans, core-satellite allocation, and long-horizon cases.
scope_item_3: The final ranking compares execution drag, holding cost, and structural friction.
contact_note: For methodology, data, or partnerships, use the contact page or write directly to support.
disclaimer: Informational tool. Results do not constitute personalized investment advice.
